quotes.text: The character-defining features of the Maj. Kunkel House include the one-story height, rectangular plan, low pitched gabled roof and shed dormer with shallow overhanging eaves and exposed rafter tails, wood clapboard siding, recessed front porch, and wood casement windows.
quotes.page: HABS CA-2969; the nearest marker legible in the extract, '(Page 7)', precedes this span

quotes.text: 1. Overall dimensions: The house is approximately 31' wide, 52' deep, and 15' tall.
quotes.page: HABS CA-2969, Part II.B.1; between the '(Page 7)' and '(Page 8)' markers

quotes.text: 2. Foundations: The foundation is concrete. The thickness varies to accommodate changes in grade.
quotes.page: HABS CA-2969, Part II.B.2; same span

quotes.text: 3. Walls: The exterior walls are sheathed with wood clapboard that has been texture coated.
quotes.page: HABS CA-2969, Part II.B.3; same span

quotes.text: 4. Structural system, framing: The house has a wood frame and floors. Interior bearing walls are 2" by 4" wood studs.
quotes.page: HABS CA-2969, Part II.B.4; same span

quotes.text: 5. Porches, stoops, balconies, porticos, bulkheads: The front porch at the south end of the west façade is recessed. It is approached by a short flight of non-original brick and stone steps. The floor is stained wood plank, and the ceiling is wood beadboard. The square porch pillars are in their original locations but have been clad in non-original stone with brick caps. The square wood posts are original.
quotes.page: HABS CA-2969, Part II.B.5; same span
HABS CA-2969, Part II.B.6; same span

quotes.text: b. Windows and shutters: Windows are distributed irregularly across all facades. Window openings are rectangular in shape, different in size, surrounded by plain MAJOR HARRY E. KUNKEL HOUSE HABS CA-2969 (Page 8) wood frames with lug sills, and filled with wood casements and sashes. Casement windows have vertical and horizontal wood muntins at the top and are found along the west, north, and south facades. Double hung sash windows are found on the east façade.
quotes.page: HABS CA-2969 (Page 8); the running head falls inside the span and is quoted as printed

quotes.text: 8. Roof: a. Shape, covering: The low pitched, side gabled roof is covered with non-original composition shingles. b. Cornice, eaves: The roof has overhanging eaves with exposed rafter tails and non-original knee braces.
c. Dormers, cupolas, towers: There is a shed dormer centered on the west side of the roof. It has three windows and details like the main roof.
1. Floor plans: The first and only floor is approximately 1,088 square feet and includes a living room, dining room, kitchen, utility room, two bedrooms, and one bathroom. 2. Stairways: None.
